items.title: Sales Director Argentina
items.description: About the Role We are looking for an experienced and commercially driven Director of Sales to lead and grow our commercial strategy at Futbol Sites . This is a leadership position for a senior professional with a strong network and proven track record in digital media advertising . The ideal candidate combines deep market knowledge with strong commercial expertise, a strategic mindset, and the ability to build long-term relationships with advertisers, agencies, brands, and strategic partners. Based in Buenos Aires , you will be responsible for leading your team to drive revenue growth across the market, developing new business opportunities, strengthening key client relationships, and leading a high-performing sales team. You will play a key role in positioning Futbol Sites as a leading sports media partner and identifying new opportunities across the evolving digital advertising ecosystem. What You'll Do Commercial Leadership & Strategy Instill a partnership-first mindset across the team, coaching reps to prioritize long-term relationship depth and strategic account growth over transactional, campaign-by-campaign selling. Define and execute the commercial strategy for the market, aligned with Futbol Sites' regional and global objectives. Identify new revenue opportunities across digital media, sports, football, branded content, programmatic, sponsorships, and other relevant commercial solutions. Develop and maintain a strong understanding of market dynamics, advertiser needs, agency structures, competitors, and emerging digital media trends. Contribute to the evolution of Futbol Sites' commercial offering and go-to-market strategy. Team Leadership Lead, coach, and develop the commercial team, setting clear objectives, priorities, and performance expectations. Build a high-performing, collaborative, and results-oriented sales culture. Support team members in developing strategic accounts, closing complex opportunities, and expanding existing business. Monitor team performance, pipeline development, revenue forecasts, and achievement against targets. Identify opportunities to strengthen capabilities, processes, and commercial best practices across the team. Business Development & Sales Lead the identification and acquisition of new clients, advertisers, agencies, and strategic partners. Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers across brands, media agencies, advertising agencies, and the sports ecosystem. Personally manage and develop strategic and high-value accounts. Lead major commercial pitches, negotiations, and partnership discussions. Develop innovative and customized commercial proposals that combine Futbol Sites' digital media assets, audience, content, and sports expertise. Ensure consistent achievement of revenue and business growth targets. Market & Industry Leadership Maintain a strong network and active presence within the digital media, advertising, sports, and fútbol industries . Represent Futbol Sites at relevant industry events, meetings, conferences, and client activities. Stay ahead of changes in digital advertising, media consumption, audience behavior, sports marketing, and competitive offerings. Bring market intelligence and new commercial ideas into the organization. Identify opportunities to position Futbol Sites at the forefront of the digital sports media ecosystem. Cross-Functional Collaboration Work closely with Marketing, Content, Revenue Operations, Ad Operations, Programmatic, and other internal teams to ensure successful execution of commercial initiatives. Partner with regional and global stakeholders to share market insights and identify opportunities across Argentina Ensure that client expectations and commercial commitments are clearly communicated and effectively delivered. What We're Looking For Leadership Experience: Proven experience leading and developing commercial or sales teams, preferably within digital media, advertising, sports, or technology companies. Industry Expertise: Strong background in the digital media and advertising industry , with a solid understanding of the sports and/or fútbol ecosystem. Commercial Track Record: Demonstrated success in developing new business, managing strategic accounts, negotiating complex deals, and consistently achieving revenue targets. Industry Network: Established relationships with advertisers, brands, media agencies, advertising agencies, and/or key players within the sports ecosystem. Market Knowledge: Deep understanding of digital advertising, media sales, branded content, sponsorships, audience monetization, and current industry trends. Leadership Skills: Strong ability to inspire, coach, and develop teams while maintaining a high-performance culture. Strategic Mindset: Ability to translate market opportunities into actionable commercial strategies and measurable business results. Communication & Negotiation: Excellent presentation, communication, influencing, and negotiation skills, with confidence interacting with senior stakeholders and decision-makers. Analytical & Business Acumen: Strong understanding of sales pipelines, forecasting, commercial KPIs, revenue performance, and business planning. Tools: Strong proficiency in PowerPoint/Keynote, Excel, CRM platforms, and other commercial tools. Education: University degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, Advertising, or a related field is preferred. Languages: Advanced English is preferred. Location: Based in Buenos Aires with full-time availability. What Success Looks Like Consistent growth in commercial revenue and market share. A strong and well-developed sales pipeline. Successful acquisition and retention of strategic clients and partners. A high-performing and engaged commercial team. Strong positioning and visibility for Futbol Sites within the digital media and sports industry. Continuous identification of new business opportunities and innovative ways to monetize our audiences and content. Lead a commercial team that thinks and sells like partnership builders and generates strategic value of the relationships they own.

items.description: About Playtech Founded in 1999, the company has a premium listing on the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange and is focused on regulated and regulating markets across its B2B business. By leveraging its proprietary technology, Playtech delivers innovative products and services to ensure a safe, engaging and entertaining gaming experience. As the gaming industry's leading technology company, it combines business intelligence-driven software, services, content, and platform technology to drive excellence and innovation across the sector. Read more about who we are and what we do here: www.playtechpeople.com and www.playtech.com Here at Playtech, we genuinely believe that people are our biggest asset. Diverse thoughts, experiences, and individual characteristics enrich our work environment and lead to better business decisions. Embracing differences and maintaining transparency in our processes is the core of Playtech's overall commitment to responsible business practices. Ready to level up your career? We are looking for an exceptional Account Manager to join our ever-growing #PlaytechWorld. As a market leader in the gambling and financial trading industries, Playtech is at the forefront of delivering business intelligence-driven gambling software, services, content, and platform technology. If you are passionate about the gaming industry and thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment, we want to hear from you! Your influential mission. You will... Be on top of customer business models, including marketing strategies (e.g., bonuses, admin usage). Manage day-to-day commercial contact between Playtech customers and internal stakeholders. Drive customer performance and revenue growth through strategic recommendations using KPI(s) & benchmark analysis. Promote tasks internally, including development requests and initiation of new projects. Assist the Regional Director in working on group-wide deals. Ensure customers are aware of and utilize new Playtech products. Provide customers with appropriate marketing materials for promoting all products. Maximize revenues and profits through existing products and channels by developing account management tools. Maintain excellent relationships with each Playtech customer through regular communication and meetings. Coordinate the interface of Playtech’s project management, translation, finance, compliance, and legal processes with customer’s equivalent staff. Maintain detailed customer relationship information and share regularly with colleagues/management. Develop new marketing initiatives with customers. Maintain detailed information on Playtech competition in the online market for regular feedback into the team. Provide first-level business support and act as an escalation point for technical issues. Attend exhibitions and events. Conduct operational audits. Components for success. You... Are highly self-motivated and can work well autonomously. Possess a high level of emotional intelligence (EQ) and are passionate about the gaming industry. Have excellent written and spoken English, Spanish and Portuguese skills. Have experience managing or working with international and external customers. Have experience with a software or internet company in a relevant position. Are detail-oriented, self-managed, a team player, and capable of multitasking. Are service and business-oriented with excellent interpersonal skills. Have strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. Have knowledge of internet advertising (an advantage). Can prioritize and manage client engagements effectively. Have proven negotiation skills. Have a background in managing legal contracts and documents (an advantage). Have proven ability to manage multiple client relationships and grow revenues. Have an interest in and knowledge of sports, betting, casino games, and poker. Understand IT platforms, systems, and development processes. Are good with numbers. Have experience in the online gaming industry. Have at least 2 years of experience or background in Customer Services/Customer Support B2B. You'll get extra points for... Knowledge of internet advertising. Background in managing legal contracts and documents. Proven ability to manage multiple client relationships. Interest in and knowledge of sports, betting, casino games, and poker. Thrive in a culture that values... A competitive salary and bonus scheme. A fantastic team culture. Opportunities to work in the gaming industry with one of the top teams in the sector. Professional growth and educational development opportunities. An inclusive environment where differences are celebrated, and everyone is encouraged to be themselves at work. HOW TO APPLY? In addition to your CV, please add a brief motivation letter covering your goals, your current experience in account management or related fields, and/or working in a corporate environment. You can write it in the comment section at the end of the application page (under “your message to the hiring manager”). Account Manager Team Join our dynamic team and be part of a great business unit that values innovation, collaboration, and growth. Our team is dedicated to pushing the boundaries of the gaming industry and delivering exceptional results for our clients. Playtech is an equal opportunities employer. Our mission is to welcome everyone and create inclusive teams. We celebrate differences and encourage everyone to join us and be themselves at work.

items.title: Senior Affiliates Manager (m/f/d)
items.description: Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing . Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market. Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns. Team You will join our B2C DACH Team, which manages our core markets in Germany and Austria. We are a collaborative group of commercial and growth professionals focused on delivering exceptional platform experiences, maintaining high customer trust, and driving sustainable, cost-effective customer acquisition. In this role, you will work closely with the Country Head DACH and collaborate across Product, Tech, Investment/Pension, and broader Marketing departments to scale our partner channel. Your Responsibilities As our Senior Affiliate Manager DACH , you will take full ownership of driving performance-based customer growth through affiliate and strategic brand partnerships. You will act as both a strategic manager and a hands-on executor to acquire new partners and maximise the performance of existing relationships. End-to-End Partner & Campaign Management: Manage and scale our affiliate marketing programs in the DACH region to ensure consistent, sustainable growth within defined CPR (Cost per Registration) and CAC (Customer Acquisition Cost) targets. Proactive Partner Acquisition ("Hunting"): Continuously map, identify, and acquire high-converting new partners (financial comparison engines, specialised publishers, content creators, and influencers) and strategic brand-to-brand partnerships using direct outreach and industry networks. Key Account Growth ("Farming"): Build and nurture strong, long-term relationships with top-tier DACH affiliate partners. Conduct regular site audits to ensure integrations, interest rates, landing pages, and promotional assets remain accurate and fully optimised. Cross-Functional & Product Line Expansion: Collaborate closely with specialised teams (such as Investment and Pension) to launch targeted affiliate initiatives that drive acquisition for specific high-growth financial products. Operational & Tracking Excellence: Ensure seamless tracking setup, precise campaign attribution, remuneration contract management, and efficient invoicing processes across our network partners (e.g., Impact, financeAds). Data-Driven Performance & Cost Control: Rigorously monitor channel performance, competitor activities, and market trends using Looker and HubSpot. Ensure cost efficiency and ROI superiority compared to other paid acquisition channels. Process Innovation & Internal Advocacy: Continually evaluate, test, and innovate our affiliate processes while serving as the primary subject matter expert and advocate for marketing partnerships across the company. Your Profile Must-Haves Relevant Experience: At least 5 years of professional experience in Affiliate Marketing, Partner Management, or performance marketing within the DACH region. Deep Domain & Technical Knowledge: Solid understanding of tracking setups, attribution models, affiliate network mechanics (e.g., Impact, financeAds), commercial remuneration structures, and digital marketing trends. Commercial & Analytical Mindset: Proven track record of managing performance budgets, maintaining target acquisition costs (CPR/CAC), and utilising data analytics tools (e.g., Looker, Excel) to optimise campaign outcomes. Strong Interpersonal & Negotiation Skills: Excellent communication skills with a hands-on, proactive attitude and a strong commitment to team collaboration and problem-solving. Language Proficiency: Business fluency in both German and English (written and spoken) is required to manage partner relationships and engage effectively within our international team. Nice-to-Haves FinTech & Financial Product Interest: Prior experience or strong curiosity regarding personal finance, banking products, investments, or pension topics. Tool Familiarity: Practical experience working with CRM and affiliate software platforms such as HubSpot, Impact, or similar enterprise partner management suites. AI & Automation Curiosity: Experience leveraging Generative AI tools to streamline routine partner communication, market research, or operational workflows. Join our mission, join our team – and grow with us! At Raisin, we care about each other and it is one of our top priorities to foster an open and caring environment in which everyone feels welcome and comfortable. Our culture is strongly driven by our ambitious team, which connects more than 75 different nationalities. As part of our team, you will benefit from: Employee Development Budget of €2,000 and four full training days per year. Flexible working hours, home office and 30 vacation days. A company pension scheme (Betriebliche Altersvorsorge), which we support with 20%. Enjoy more than 50+ different sports with Urban Sports Club: We subsidise your membership with more than €20 per month. Do you miss being in the office? The Deutschland Ticket gets you there, which we subsidise with €25 per month. Love cycling? With JobRad, lease the bike of your choice and enjoy tax savings, plus Raisin covers your monthly insurance costs. Hungry all the time? Snacks, daily fresh fruit as well as drinks provided at the office. You are moving from another country or city to join us? We may support your relocation. Raisin Applicant Privacy Policy We value diversity and the unique experiences each individual brings. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for everyone, regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity.

Welcome to Fireblocks , the industry-leading digital asset infrastructure technology company responsible for 15% of all crypto transactions! Here’s the bit about us: Fireblocks is an enterprise-grade platform delivering a secure infrastructure for moving, storing, and issuing digital assets & cryptocurrencies. At Fireblocks, we enable businesses to securely build, run and scale digital asset operations through the Fireblocks Network and MPC-based Wallet Infrastructure. Our next-generation multi-layer technology protects Digital assets from cyber-attacks, internal collusion, and human error. Fireblocks is the only platform that provides insurance for digital assets in storage, transfer, and E&O. As of January 2026, we serve over 2400 institutional customers, have secured the transfer of over $10 trillion in digital assets, and are the world's highest-valued digital asset infrastructure company, with over $1 billion raised. Our mission is simple: Enable every business to easily and securely support digital assets & cryptocurrencies. Come join us as we Secure. Simplify. As a key member of a leading blockchain and cybersecurity firm, you will target PSP, Cross-Border, Remittances and various other payment providers whilst collaborating closely with regional sales teams, Sales Engineers, and the Payments product team. You’ll be: Meeting and exceeding monthly and quarterly revenue targets. Collaborating with the Fireblocks BDR and GTM teams to generate and qualify leads. Building and nurturing strong relationships with prospects and customers. Conducting prospecting, territory, and account planning to identify new opportunities. Keeping the Fireblocks CRM up-to-date with accurate account and pipeline information. items.title: Commercial Operations Team Lead
items.description: About Legend Legend is a world-leading sports and gaming media network, reaching hundreds of millions of visitors a year. We're now part of Genius Sports. Together, we’re combining Legend’s audience, brands and product expertise with Genius Sports’ real-time data, technology and capabilities to create the next generation of fan-facing media and advertising Here at Legend, we're building next-level player experiences. With 20+ years of proven success we’re the world's leading Sports and Gaming marketing company. Our people are our edge. 600+ sharp, ambitious Legends across 22+ countries who move fast, learn quickly and win together. Here growth isn’t a perk, it’s the standard. You’ll stretch, level-up and carve out a career as bold as the products we build. We celebrate wins and create experiences that people talk about for years - for our players & for each other. If you’re ready to shape the future of player experience and enjoy the ride while you do it, this is where you’ll thrive. The Role Legend is hiring a Commercial Operations Team Lead to join our Commercial team and lead a talented team responsible for keeping the data and operational processes behind our partnerships running accurately, efficiently and at pace. This isn't a traditional Data Analyst role. It's an operations leadership role in a data-rich environment. You'll take ownership of a busy, deadline-driven operation, helping your team manage large volumes of commercial data accurately while continually looking for smarter ways to work. You'll spot bottlenecks, challenge inefficient processes and use automation, technology and AI to help us scale. Just as importantly, you'll lead the people behind the operation. We want someone who knows how to delegate, develop a team, protect their capacity and create an environment where people can perform at their best, even when things get busy. If you're the kind of leader who sees a complicated process and immediately starts thinking about how to make it simpler, faster and better, this could be a great opportunity for you. Your Impact: Lead and develop a high-performing team, creating clear priorities, delegating effectively and building a positive culture where people feel supported, challenged and able to do their best work. Own critical commercial operations cycles, ensuring large volumes of data are reviewed, processed and delivered accurately against demanding daily and monthly deadlines. Make our operation smarter, identifying bottlenecks and manual processes and introducing improvements through better workflows, automation, AI and technology. Get to the root of problems, spotting anomalies and investigating whether issues sit within data, mapping, logic or process before recommending practical solutions. Manage competing priorities, understanding team capacity, escalating risks early and confidently challenging or reprioritising work when everything can't happen at once. Help us scale, building processes that can handle increasing volume and complexity without relying on simply adding more people. What You'll Bring: Strong people leadership experience within a fast-paced operations environment, with the ability to delegate, coach, motivate and manage a busy team rather than trying to do everything yourself. A process-improvement mindset and examples of where you've simplified, automated or redesigned operational workflows to improve efficiency, quality or scalability. Strong analytical and logical thinking. You don't need to be a Data Analyst or know SQL, but you should be comfortable working with large volumes of data, spotting trends and anomalies and investigating root causes. Confidence working to tight deadlines and managing competing priorities, with the judgement to know what needs immediate attention, what can wait and when something needs escalating. A proactive, solutions-focused approach. You don't just identify problems, you investigate them, bring ideas and help move things forward. Confidence with Excel and operational systems, alongside the curiosity to learn new tools quickly and explore how technology and AI can improve the way your team works. The Interview Process: We want our interview process to give you a genuine feel for the role, the team and the challenges you'll be taking on while giving us the opportunity to understand how you think, lead and solve problems. 1st: Initial chat with our Talent Partner – 30 minutes via Zoom 2nd: Interview with our Commercial Team – we'll explore your experience across people leadership, operations, process improvement and problem-solving through real examples and situational questions. 3rd: Take-Home Task - You'll be given a short take-home task based on realistic scenarios you could encounter in the role. Final: Task Discussion & Leadership Interview - You'll meet with our Head of Commercial Optimisation and People Partner to discuss your approach to the task and explore your leadership style, operational judgement and how you would approach some of the real challenges you'll face in the role. We'll give you everything you need to prepare ahead of each stage. Additional Information When you apply for a role with Legend through the Genius Sports careers site, the information you provide as part of your application will initially be collected through Genius Sports' recruitment software provider, Greenhouse, on our behalf and for our purposes only. Your application and related personal data may then be transferred to our recruitment platform, Lever, where it will be processed in accordance with our privacy notice, which you can find here https://l1.com/privacy-policy Legend is an Equal Opportunity Employer, but that’s just the start. We believe different perspectives help us grow and achieve more. That’s why we’re dedicated to hiring and developing the most talented and diverse team- which includes individuals with different backgrounds, abilities, identities and experiences. If you require any reasonable adjustments throughout your application process, please speak to your Talent Partner or contact the team on talent@l1.com , and we'll do all we can to support you.

You provide the critical challenge required for driving revenue and margin, guiding business counterparts through a transformative planning process that prioritizes drivers over pure outcomes. Proactive revenue performance analysis: move past outcomes to identify the specific revenue drivers (e.g., usage, churn, pricing, market) that management must focus on. Revenue forecast pressure-testing: Interrogate the inputs that feed our global P&L to ensure every forecast is achievable and rooted in actionable drivers. Logic refinement: Identify and dismantle broken assumptions in commercial plans and rebuild them into actionable, robust frameworks. Causal synthesis: Translate complex technical and commercial data into clear, authoritative narratives for senior stakeholders. Key responsibilities Driver autopsy: Conduct deep-dives into revenue beats or misses to distinguish between one-time windfalls and core structural trends. Planning guidance: Lead commercial counterparts through the forecasting and budgeting process to ensure submissions are robust and logically sound. Business modeling: Create elegant solutions for complex business topics like pricing elasticity and market entry costs. Build automated revenue reporting using advanced analytical and reporting tools on top of data warehouse and billing data sets to steer commercial decision making ABOUT YOU You ask smart questions and refuse to accept surface-level explanations. You enable business success by providing the "so-what" that others miss. You are a "fixer" who enjoys the challenge of untangling messy data problems to find a clear path forward. What we're looking for Experience : 3-5 years in a multidisciplinary finance, analytics, and/or consulting role. Archetype : We seek high proficiency in either commercial finance or commercial analytics. Education : MBA or relevant master’s degree preferred. Technical requirement : SQL, Power BI / Tableau, and AI agents knowledge is essential. Experience with Python or n8n/workflow automation is highly valued. Mindset : An "accountability" mindset - you value the strength of a plan over the speed of its delivery. OUR OFFER: A collaborative environment with colleagues from all over the world (Offices in Europe, Asia and US) including various social events and teambuilding. Flexibility to manage your workday and tasks with autonomy. A balance of structure and autonomy to tackle your daily tasks. items.title: Senior Performance Marketing Manager (m/f/d)
items.description: Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing . Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market. Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns. Team Embedded directly within our PPC team, this role drives customer acquisition across key online channels including SEA, Display, App campaigns, and Native Ads. Beyond core performance marketing, you will take full ownership of high-impact, cross-functional initiatives that bridge the Marketing department with broader company-wide teams. Your Responsibilities As a Senior Performance Marketing Manager, you will play a crucial role in developing and implementing high-impact marketing campaigns across all our international markets, covering various languages and products. From inception to execution, you will be responsible for delivering and scaling performance marketing campaigns to drive growth and maximize conversion rates. That means: Lead, plan, and execute compelling performance marketing campaigns to increase conversion rates and enhance brand awareness in alignment with our targets. Drive performance marketing channels to effectively support the complete consumer funnel, ensuring efficient CPA within allocated budgets. Still you are always welcome to identify opportunities to scale further, challenging the status quo and budget restrictions. Leverage AI to further automate and optimise campaign management, embracing new opportunities coming up. Develop strategies for existing channels and explore new opportunities for media testing to optimise lead quality. Collaborate with Marketing leaders to oversee media planning, asset development, implementation, measurement, and reporting for Performance Marketing efforts. Confidently present campaign strategies, results, and actionable insights to stakeholders at all levels of the business, up to executive leadership. What distinguishes this position? This role offers the opportunity to see the direct impact of your work on the team's processes and the results we achieve. At Raisin, we value teamwork, enjoyment, and personal development, fostering an open and appreciative feedback culture. Your Profile 3 to 5+ years experience in performance marketing. Proven track record of delivering impactful performance marketing strategies, campaigns, and optimisations, with the ideal candidate having worked in an agency setting. Proven international experience. An absolute must is the practical use of AI, specifically building gems or AI agents. Excellent knowledge of the ad platforms and networks, Google (Search, Display, App and Performance Max), Microsoft Advertising (Search, MSAN), Apple Search Ads. Good knowledge of other ad platforms and networks, including Social Ads (e.g. Meta, LinkedIn, Reddit) and Native Ads (e.g. Outbrain). Strong analytical skills, with the ability to derive actionable insights from data and effectively communicate them to diverse stakeholders. Demonstrated strategic thinking, translating quantitative and qualitative data into effective marketing strategies. Solid understanding of customer segmentation and its application in media planning, buying, and campaign development. Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, results-oriented environment and manage multiple projects effectively. Exceptional organisational skills, attention to detail, and a sense of urgency and follow-through. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. A team player with the ability to work autonomously and take ownership. Nice to have Additional technical experience with tracking technology (e.g., Google Tag Manager, Adjust or other marketing-related tools). Familiarity with Google Looker as a business intelligence platform. Join our mission, join our team – and grow with us! At Raisin, we care about each other and it is one of our top priorities to foster an open and caring environment in which everyone feels welcome and comfortable. Our culture is strongly driven by our ambitious team, which connects more than 75 different nationalities. As part of our team, you will benefit from: Employee Development Budget of €2,000 and four full training days per year. Flexible working hours, home office and 30 vacation days. A company pension scheme (Betriebliche Altersvorsorge), which we support with 20%. Enjoy more than 50+ different sports with Urban Sports Club: We subsidize your membership with more than €20 per month. Do you miss being in the office? The Deutschland Ticket gets you there, which we subsidize with €25 per month. Love cycling? With JobRad, lease the bike of your choice and enjoy tax savings, plus Raisin covers your monthly insurance costs. Hungry all the time? Snacks, daily fresh fruit as well as drinks provided at the office. You are moving from another country or city to join us? We may support your relocation. Raisin Applicant Privacy Policy We value diversity and the unique experiences each individual brings. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for everyone, regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity.

items.title: Senior Affiliate Platform Operations Manager (Affilireach)
items.description: As Senior Affiliate Platform Operations Manager , you will own the day-to-day operational management of AffiliReach , Better Collective’s sub-affiliate platform. You will ensure that publishers, advertisers, campaigns, deals, tracking setups, bonuses and platform configurations are accurate, reliable and ready to scale. You will work closely with Commercial, Product, BI/Data and technical teams, acting as the key operational point of contact for the platform and helping turn commercial agreements into robust operational setups. Job Responsibilities AffiliReach Platform Operations Own the day-to-day operational management of the AffiliReach platform. Set up and maintain publisher accounts, advertiser accounts, campaigns, brands and deals within the platform. Configure commission structures and campaign settings based on agreed commercial terms provided by the relevant commercial teams. Ensure platform information is complete, accurate and kept up to date. Support onboarding of new publishers and brands from an operational and technical perspective. Manage user access, account configuration and other platform administration. Act as the main internal point of contact for operational platform questions. Tracking & Internal Systems Create, test, manage and maintain tracking links across publishers, campaigns and advertisers. Work with internal and external affiliate tracking platforms and tools to ensure correct tracking and attribution. Set up and maintain deeplinks and other campaign-specific tracking requirements. Test tracking before campaigns go live and troubleshoot discrepancies or broken tracking. Monitor tracking functionality and proactively flag issues that could impact publisher performance or reporting. Maintain accurate documentation of tracking setups, processes and configurations. Work with BI/Data and technical teams to investigate differences between operator data, internal tracking and AffiliReach platform reporting. Publisher Bonuses & Promotional Updates Manage operational updates related to publisher-facing bonuses, promotions and campaign information. Ensure new or updated bonus information is correctly reflected within AffiliReach and relevant internal systems. Coordinate with internal teams to collect the information required for bonus and promotional updates. Support the setup of new offers and ensure publishers have access to accurate and current campaign information. Perform regular checks to identify outdated or incorrect offers and coordinate necessary updates. Campaign & Deal Setup Translate agreed commercial deals into the correct operational setup within AffiliReach. Configure CPA, revenue share, hybrid, fixed-fee and other campaign structures supported by the platform. Ensure publisher-specific rates and campaign conditions are configured correctly. Maintain clear records of active and inactive campaigns and their associated configurations. Support campaign launches by ensuring all operational requirements are completed before activation. Product & Data Collaboration Collaborate with Product and Data teams to support smooth platform operations and resolve tracking or data issues. Provide operational feedback and support testing when needed. Create and maintain clear documentation of operational processes, platform setups and workflows. Job Requirements Experience working in affiliate operations, performance marketing operations, affiliate networks or a similar digital environment. Good understanding of affiliate tracking and attribution. Experience working with affiliate platforms or tracking systems such as Income Access, MyAffiliates, Cellxpert or similar. Strong attention to detail, particularly when working with tracking links, campaign configurations and performance data. Comfortable working with data and identifying discrepancies. Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to investigate issues until they are resolved. Ability to work independently and take ownership of operational processes. Good communication skills and ability to coordinate effectively across Product, BI/Data, Commercial and Operations teams. Good to have Experience within sports betting, casino or iGaming. Previous experience working with sub-affiliate or affiliate-network platforms. Experience with deeplink creation and management. Familiarity with different commission models, including CPA, revenue share, hybrid and fixed-fee arrangements. Experience with QA/testing of digital platforms. Experience documenting operational processes and workflows. Interest in using AI and automation to reduce manual operational work and improve data quality and efficiency. Benefits Private health insurance Sick leave 100% paid Canteen with free meals and drinks Flexible working hours Additional vacation days after two years in the company We also provide up-to date equipment, entertainment facilities in a modern office right in the city center and more. Application Deadline We look forward to hearing from you and accept applications until 29th October. Please submit your CV and cover letter in PDF; only applications submitted in English will be considered. Expected start date: as soon as possible.

items.title: Senior Performance Marketing Manager
items.description: [Full-time] • Remote At Boldin, we believe financial confidence should be accessible to everyone. Money decisions shape our lives, yet too often people are left without the clarity or tools they need to make informed choices. We exist to change that. Boldin is a comprehensive financial planning platform that helps people understand their financial picture, make smarter decisions with their money and time, and plan for the future with confidence. With over $20M raised and strong momentum, Boldin is entering a pivotal phase of growth. This is an opportunity to join a mission-driven team and help shape the future. About This Role We're looking for a Senior Performance Marketing Manager to own paid user acquisition end to end. You'll own the paid budget, the channel mix, and the number. Today, that means search and paid social do the heavy lifting; from there, you'll decide where we expand next—CTV, podcast, and paid sponsorships, or somewhere we haven't tried yet. You'll make that call based on what the data says, not what's fashionable. This is a hands-on role with real scope. You'll be in the accounts, writing copy, setting up landing page tests, reporting out on the numbers, and hitting our CAC targets. You'll work directly with our Head of Growth, and closely with data, product, lifecycle, and creative partners. If you like to be hands-on while driving the strategy, this is a good fit. Key Responsibilities Own paid acquisition strategy and execution across all paid channels, with an initial focus on SEM and paid social, then expanding into CTV, paid sponsorships, and new channels as the data supports it. Own the paid media budget: allocation across channels, pacing, and reallocation away from non efficient spend toward what's working Run end-to-end campaign management—strategy, build, launch, optimization, analysis, and reporting Optimize account performance through ongoing keyword work, ad copy testing, campaign structure improvements, and bid strategy Build a consistent testing cadence across ad copy, creative formats, audiences, targeting, and landing pages, and turn results into a documented learning loop Partner with product and design to improve landing page and funnel conversion rates, bringing specific recommendations rather than general feedback Manage performance against efficiency targets (CAC, LTV:CAC, CPA, ROAS) rather than top-of-funnel volume alone, and connect paid spend to registrations, trial starts, and new customer revenue. Analyze audience and placement data to find new opportunities and cut inefficient segments Report on paid performance and test results weekly, and translate results into a clear point of view on what we do next Partner with our data team to make sure attribution, tracking, and conversion measurement are trustworthy—and flag it loudly when they aren't Evaluate and manage agencies, vendors, and tools where they extend our capacity Evolve the acquisition roadmap based on performance, seasonality, competitive shifts, and new audience insight Requirements 6+ years in performance marketing or paid acquisition, with meaningful time in a consumer/B2C environment Hands-on operator experience in Google Ads and paid social (Meta at minimum; Reddit, LinkedIn, YouTube, or TikTok a plus)—you've built and optimized accounts yourself, not just briefed an agency Track record of owning a paid budget of at least $1M annually and hitting efficiency targets, with specific numbers you can walk through Strong analytical skills: comfortable pulling your own numbers from BI or warehouse layer, and able to build your own reporting rather than waiting on someone else Working understanding of attribution, incrementality, and measurement limitations—you know when a number is directional vs. reliable Experience with subscription or freemium business models, and comfort optimizing to downstream revenue rather than lead volume Demonstrated CRO instincts and experience partnering on landing page and funnel testing Clear written communication—you can explain performance and tradeoffs to a leadership audience without a translator Comfortable operating in a small, fast-moving team where you set your own priorities Salary Range $140,000 – $175,000 + Equity + Performance Based Bonus - DOE We want to be as inclusive as possible in our hiring process. If you don’t have 100% of what we’re looking for, but feel like you’re pretty close to growing into the role — please still apply. If a candidate has only 80% of the skills but a fantastic attitude and perspective, they might be the perfect fit. Boldin values the unique perspectives and contributions of all individuals and we strive to foster a diverse and inclusive culture. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, including and not limited to people of any race, ethnicity, or national origin, individuals with differing abilities, members of the LGBTQ+ community, veterans, gender minorities, women and people from underrepresented communities.We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for applicants with differing abilities throughout the recruitment process. If you require any accommodations, please let us know, and we will work with you to meet your needs. We are committed to fostering an environment where everyone can bring their authentic selves to work. If you are comfortable doing so we invite you to share your preferred pronouns in your application. #LI-REMOTE

items.title: Partner Manager - Public Sector Partnerships
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. ABOUT THE ROLE We're looking for an experienced partnerships leader to build and scale ElevenLabs' Public Sector Partner Programme in North America — bringing together resellers, VARs, and systems integrators who help deploy our technology across federal agencies, state and local governments, and education institutions. You'll own the public sector partner strategy end-to-end — from building relationships with leading SIs and VARs with established public sector practices, to onboarding, enabling, and activating them to sell and deliver ElevenLabs products into government and education accounts. This is a 0→1 build: you'll design partner incentive and enablement models tailored to the procurement and compliance realities of the public sector, generate qualified pipeline through partner-led opportunities, and scale the programme against North America growth targets — while owning day-to-day execution and partner performance. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE (FIRST 6–9 MONTHS) - Partner-Sourced & Influenced Revenue: closed-won ARR through VARs, SIs, and channel partners reaching at least 20% of North America public sector revenue - Partner-Sourced Pipeline: qualified pipeline created through partners, with a focus on enterprise and agency-level opportunities in federal, SLED, and education - Revenue-Producing Partners: number of partners actively generating pipeline, opportunities, or revenue each quarter - Time-to-First Revenue: speed from partner onboarding to first sourced opportunity and first closed-won deal - Strategic Account Penetration: new agency and institution relationships unlocked through partners that ElevenLabs would've struggled to access directly REQUIREMENTS - 10+ years building and scaling SaaS or Cloud solutions into public sector markets, with a deep network across federal, SLED, and education that you can leverage from day one - 4+ years owning VAR and SI partnerships in the public sector, with proven experience driving joint account planning, co-sell motions, and revenue — not just relationship management - Deep familiarity with government procurement cycles, contract vehicles (e.g. GSA schedules, BPAs), and compliance frameworks (FedRAMP, FISMA, StateRAMP) - A builder mindset — experience creating partner motions from 0→1, rather than inheriting a mature programme - Comfortable working with technical, API-driven products, and able to explain complex concepts to partners and agency stakeholders Bonus: Mix of 3–4 years in direct public sector sales + 3–4 years in partnerships or channel; prior experience at a company scaling into gov-tech from a commercial base We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

items.title: Head of Digital Natives & Startups, ANZ
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role We are seeking a Head of Digital Natives & Startups, ANZ to build and lead Anthropic's go-to-market motion for digital native businesses and startups across Australia and New Zealand. You will grow a team that wins and expands the region's fastest-moving, AI-forward companies, driving consumption of Claude directly and through our cloud partners. You will set the segment strategy, hire and develop the team, and work closely with Product, Partnerships and Marketing to turn ANZ builders into long-term customers. This is a chance to shape how one of the world's most dynamic startup ecosystems adopts frontier AI, while representing ANZ's priorities to our global leadership. Key responsibilities Define and execute the ANZ go-to-market strategy for Digital Natives and Startups, covering both new customer acquisition and growth within existing accounts Build, hire and lead a high-performing sales team across Australia and New Zealand, with clear targets, regular coaching and defined career paths Own pipeline, forecast and consumption targets for the segment, running a consumption-based sales motion Build a repeatable motion across the customer lifecycle, from early-stage founders to scaled, high-growth digital natives Develop strong relationships across the ANZ startup ecosystem, including founders, venture investors, accelerators and developer communities Partner with cloud providers and our Partnerships team to co-sell and extend our reach in the segment Collaborate with Product, Marketing, Solutions and Customer Success to adapt our offering and messaging for ANZ, and bring customer feedback back to the business Represent ANZ priorities to regional and global leadership, and keep local execution aligned with global strategy Act as an executive sponsor for key customers and communicate Anthropic's trust and safety principles with credibility Minimum qualifications 15+ years of overall experience selling technology products to enterprise organisations across ANZ market 5+ years of people management experience leading sales teams in the digital native and/or startup segment Proven success in consumption-based technology sales, such as cloud, API or usage-based SaaS Experience building a business or team from the ground up in Australia and/or New Zealand Track record across both customer acquisition and account growth Strong network and credibility in the ANZ startup and digital native ecosystem Ability to explain technical products clearly to founders, engineers and executives Preferred qualifications Background at Google, AWS or a similar cloud or SaaS company Experience selling AI, machine learning or developer-focused products Experience co-selling with cloud partners and working with channel Experience hiring and scaling a team through rapid growth Familiarity with the ANZ regulatory and data-privacy landscape Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.title: Strategic Business Development Lead
items.location_text: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role We're seeking a business development lead to own Anthropic's BD partnership footprint with a small number of the world's largest and most consequential technology companies. These are not single-threaded accounts. Each relationship spans many businesses at once — consumer products, devices and operating systems, productivity and collaboration software, cloud and developer platforms, commerce, and enterprise distribution. Your job is to see the whole board, decide where Anthropic should lean in and where it shouldn't, and turn that judgment into signed deals. The center of gravity for this role is product and distribution partnerships: co-developing opportunities with partners, and structuring the commercial, technical, and go-to-market terms that make those partnerships durable. You'll typically be running several deal streams inside the same partner in parallel — at different stages, with different counterparts, and with terms that interact with one another — and you'll be the person responsible for keeping them coherent. This is an individual contributor role for a seasoned dealmaker who is comfortable as the primary counterpart to senior executives at very large companies, who brings strong judgment to ambiguous, high-stakes situations, and who can carry a complex, multi-party negotiation from first conversation through signature and into execution. Key responsibilities Manage a small number of large, multi-faceted partner relationships end to end: set the strategy for each relationship, decide which opportunities to pursue and in what order, and stay accountable for the overall health and commercial output of the partnership across every surface it touches Lead product partnerships: identify and structure opportunities to embed Claude in partners' consumer and enterprise products, co-develop new products and features, and define the product, technical, data, and brand terms that come with them, working closely with Anthropic's product and engineering leaders Run multiple deal streams in parallel: manage several concurrent negotiations within the same partner — product integrations, distribution and go-to-market, commercial and consumption agreements, and infrastructure — and sequence and connect them so terms in one stream reinforce rather than undercut the others Negotiate complex, first-of-kind agreements: lead end-to-end negotiations involving novel commercial structures, revenue and economics sharing, product and roadmap commitments, exclusivity and competitive provisions, data terms, and multi-year, multi-component value exchanges Act as an executive counterpart: build and manage relationships with senior executives and their teams on the partner side, serve as Anthropic's primary voice into the partnership, and prepare and steer Anthropic's own executives through partner-level engagements Exercise judgment on behalf of Anthropic: weigh commercial upside against strategic, competitive, product, and mission considerations; know when to say no; and make clear, well-reasoned recommendations to Anthropic leadership on trade-offs that don't have a playbook Drive cross-functional execution: coordinate Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Legal, and Policy across the life of a partnership, from initial structuring through negotiation, launch, and ongoing governance, ensuring what we sign is something Anthropic can deliver Minimum qualifications Direct experience owning a large, multi-business partner relationship, where you were responsible for the whole relationship rather than a single deal or product line Track record of structuring and closing product partnerships — embedding technology into partner products, co-developed products, distribution through partner surfaces, or similar — in addition to conventional commercial agreements Experience personally leading complex, multi-stakeholder negotiations with senior executives, including deals with interlocking terms, competitive sensitivities, and multi-year commitments Demonstrated ability to manage several significant negotiations at the same time without losing the thread on any of them Experience coordinating cross-functional execution (e.g., Product, Engineering, Legal, Finance) to bring a complex agreement from structuring through signature and delivery Preferred qualifications 10+ years in strategic business development, strategic partnerships, or corporate development at technology companies, with meaningful time spent managing relationships with very large technology partners Experience on either side of a partnership between a foundation model or AI platform provider and a large technology company Experience working inside one of the very large technology companies, with a practical understanding of how decisions get made, who holds budget and roadmap authority, and how to navigate them Experience with partnerships that span both consumer and enterprise businesses, or that combine product, distribution, and infrastructure components in a single relationship Understanding of foundation model capabilities and how they translate into partner products, with enough technical fluency to work credibly with product and engineering leaders on both sides Background in corporate development, strategy, or a legal or finance discipline involving structuring and papering unusually complex agreements The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $300,000 — $365,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.description: [Full-time] • Remote At Boldin, we believe financial confidence should be accessible to everyone. Money decisions shape our lives, yet too often people are left without the clarity or tools they need to make informed choices. We exist to change that. Boldin is a comprehensive financial planning platform that helps people understand their financial picture, make smarter decisions with their money and time, and plan for the future with confidence. With over $20M raised and strong momentum, Boldin is entering a pivotal phase of growth. This is an opportunity to join a mission-driven team and help shape the future. About This Role We're looking for a Performance Marketing Lead to own paid user acquisition end to end. You'll own the paid budget, the channel mix, and the number. Today, that means search and paid social do the heavy lifting; from there, you'll decide where we expand next—CTV, podcast, and paid sponsorships, or somewhere we haven't tried yet. You'll make that call based on what the data says, not what's fashionable. This is a hands-on role with real scope. You'll be in the accounts, writing copy, setting up landing page tests, reporting out on the numbers, and hitting our CAC targets. You'll work directly with our Head of Growth, and closely with data, product, lifecycle, and creative partners. If you like to be hands-on while driving the strategy, this is a good fit. Key Responsibilities Own paid acquisition strategy and execution across all paid channels, with an initial focus on SEM and paid social, then expanding into CTV, paid sponsorships, and new channels as the data supports it. Own the paid media budget: allocation across channels, pacing, and reallocation away from non efficient spend toward what's working Run end-to-end campaign management—strategy, build, launch, optimization, analysis, and reporting Optimize account performance through ongoing keyword work, ad copy testing, campaign structure improvements, and bid strategy Build a consistent testing cadence across ad copy, creative formats, audiences, targeting, and landing pages, and turn results into a documented learning loop Partner with product and design to improve landing page and funnel conversion rates, bringing specific recommendations rather than general feedback Manage performance against efficiency targets (CAC, LTV:CAC, CPA, ROAS) rather than top-of-funnel volume alone, and connect paid spend to registrations, trial starts, and new customer revenue. Analyze audience and placement data to find new opportunities and cut inefficient segments Report on paid performance and test results weekly, and translate results into a clear point of view on what we do next Partner with our data team to make sure attribution, tracking, and conversion measurement are trustworthy—and flag it loudly when they aren't Evaluate and manage agencies, vendors, and tools where they extend our capacity Evolve the acquisition roadmap based on performance, seasonality, competitive shifts, and new audience insight Requirements 6+ years in performance marketing or paid acquisition, with meaningful time in a consumer/B2C environment Hands-on operator experience in Google Ads and paid social (Meta at minimum; Reddit, LinkedIn, YouTube, or TikTok a plus)—you've built and optimized accounts yourself, not just briefed an agency Track record of owning a paid budget of at least $1M annually and hitting efficiency targets, with specific numbers you can walk through Strong analytical skills: comfortable pulling your own numbers from BI or warehouse layer, and able to build your own reporting rather than waiting on someone else Working understanding of attribution, incrementality, and measurement limitations—you know when a number is directional vs. reliable Experience with subscription or freemium business models, and comfort optimizing to downstream revenue rather than lead volume Demonstrated CRO instincts and experience partnering on landing page and funnel testing Clear written communication—you can explain performance and tradeoffs to a leadership audience without a translator Comfortable operating in a small, fast-moving team where you set your own priorities Salary Range $140,000 – $175,000 + Equity + Performance Based Bonus - DOE We want to be as inclusive as possible in our hiring process. If you don’t have 100% of what we’re looking for, but feel like you’re pretty close to growing into the role — please still apply. If a candidate has only 80% of the skills but a fantastic attitude and perspective, they might be the perfect fit. Boldin values the unique perspectives and contributions of all individuals and we strive to foster a diverse and inclusive culture. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, including and not limited to people of any race, ethnicity, or national origin, individuals with differing abilities, members of the LGBTQ+ community, veterans, gender minorities, women and people from underrepresented communities.We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for applicants with differing abilities throughout the recruitment process. If you require any accommodations, please let us know, and we will work with you to meet your needs. We are committed to fostering an environment where everyone can bring their authentic selves to work. If you are comfortable doing so we invite you to share your preferred pronouns in your application. #LI-REMOTE

items.title: Affiliate Manager
items.description: Work with the Best We are Orderly, the ultimate destination for decentralized trading platforms. We are not satisfied with the limitations of centralized exchanges or the complexities of building decentralized order books. We aim to make trading easy, fast, and secure for everyone. How? By fusing the simplicity of CeFi with the power of DeFi. At the heart of the issue lies “liquidity”. Builders often grapple with a paradox; traders need liquidity, but liquidity demands traders. Our solution is simple as is bold – concentrate all liquidity into one order book. One order book that connects all the liquidity in the crypto space. Our ambition doesn't stop there. We're omnichain, championing chain abstraction. We envision seamless transactions, where the underlying blockchain is merely a detail. By concentrating liquidity, we aim to redefine the crypto landscape, making bridging and wrapped assets a thing of the past. We are Orderly, and we are here to revolutionize DeFi, democratizing access to financial opportunities and fostering a fair, equitable paradigm for all. A Glimpse into Your Future at Orderly Network Orderly's affiliate manager is responsible for building and managing a company's affiliate program, including recruiting new affiliates, maintaining relationships with existing ones, and negotiating contracts: What will you be working on? Maintain a deep, up-to-date understanding of the affiliate marketing landscape, including industry trends, emerging technologies, and key players in the crypto and blockchain space. Identify, source, and onboard the right set of affiliate partners to align with the company's product goals and business strategy. Build, maintain, and grow strong relationships with top affiliates globally, ensuring long-term partnerships and mutual success. Manage and optimize relationships with existing affiliates and clients, ensuring consistent performance and alignment with business objectives. Collaborate with affiliate partners and internal teams to design and implement campaigns; work closely with Product and Engineering teams to address affiliate needs and ensure seamless integration and execution. Who will you be working with? Maintain close collaboration with the Marketing , Operations , Product , and Business Development teams to ensure cohesive strategies and streamlined processes. About you The ability to build relationships and manage a diverse community The ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret data Proficiency in Microsoft Excel Knowledge of affiliate networks Exceptional planning and project management skills Interested in Learning More? Our hiring process begins by meeting with our People Team, who help facilitate the process of placing you in your new role. You can expect to share your experience and ideas in online video interviews with our hiring team, made up of management and potential new colleagues. If you have experience in developing trading systems or financial-related products is a plus. You can prepare for this interview by mentally organizing your strategies and opinions on topics such as Web3, cryptocurrency trading platforms, and your vision of how to succeed. Share this! Don’t be afraid of friends or co-workers stealing this job! If you are amazing and smart we will find a place for you. Check out our External Referral Incentives Program as well.

We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. Role summary The Partnerships organization is accelerating its expansion globally. We now need the architecture to scale our delivery force through partnerships to meet the next wave of enterprise demand. As part of our rapid global expansion we are looking for a Partner Sales Manager for our Cloudera partnership in the US to join our growing North America Partner GTM team. Our ambitions are high and wide, and to bring to market the most advanced AI technology, we are building a best-in-class Go-To-Market team. Builders wanted! In this role you will be instrumental in driving the strategy and execution for our Cloudera partnership across the United States. WHAT YOU WILL DO Build strategic partnership plans and executive relationships: - Negotiate or enhance partnership agreements and contracts, ensuring they are mutually beneficial and align with our company's interests - Develop and execute strategic plans to drive pipeline and co-selling activities with Cloudera US - Own end-to-end partnership responsibilities including financial business outcomes, co-sell, technical integrations, joint marketing campaigns, etc. - Expand the partnership within Cloudera to new product teams, industry sales teams, etc. - Align partner executive stakeholders to key Mistral executive counterparts Execute Cloudera plans to drive results: - Execute strategic partnership plans to achieve pipeline and revenue results as a critical part of the Global Partners and Alliances team - Serve as a point of escalation to help resolve field conflicts using your network of key contacts within both companies as well as your knowledge of each company's strategic priorities - Lead the development and communication of the partnership performance analysis, including financial performance, agreed metrics, and related insights - Provide enablement and support to strategic partners to ensure they are effectively promoting and selling our products or services Company Builder and Collaborator: - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure the successful implementation of partnership initiatives - Work with Mistral engineering and product teams to help advance the customer experience for Mistral's models and tools on Cloudera's platform, including defining new routes to market through the partnership - Develop a strong collaboration with Mistral's US GTM team to help drive pipeline and advance opportunities to closure - Align Cloudera US sales teams with Mistral's sales counterparts and facilitate a regular MBR cadence ABOUT YOU Education: Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. An MBA or advanced degree is preferred. Location: US — New York City (required). Expect travel within North America and to our HQ based in Paris. Experience: 10+ years, proven sales track record and experience in the ISV space. You are a builder, with: - Technical Credibility: Ability to understand and discuss AI/ML concepts, API integrations, and model deployment architectures. Experience with LLM platforms is a strong plus - Executive Stakeholder Management: Experience working closely with C-level or senior leadership at partner organizations. High maturity in communication, influence, and prioritization - Market Expertise: Strong network and understanding of the US technology ecosystem and regional enterprise market dynamics - Scale and Ambiguity Mindset: Experience in fast-growing environments. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.
