items.title: Paid Media Partnerships Lead
items.description: Are you ready to get the Easygo Edge? The Paid Media Partnerships Lead is a senior leader within the Paid Media team, reporting directly to the Head of Paid Media. What you’ll build with us: This role is integral to the execution of Easygo's regional and global media strategies, owning the full lifecycle of digital media partnerships from identification and assessment through to negotiation, execution, and ongoing management. This is a commercially minded, strategically led role that sits at the intersection of partnerships, brand, and performance. The Paid Media Partnerships Lead will represent the Paid Media team in integrated, cross-format opportunities that include events, ambassador deals, and sponsorships with media assets. The role requires close collaboration with the Sponsorship team, country managers, and channel leads to ensure all partnership activity is aligned with brand positioning, performance objectives, and market strategy. We know that innovation ignites when we build and create together, in person. This is a full-time opportunity at our Melbourne office. You’ll work right where it all happens, surrounded by our fearless crew shipping high-impact work. Who is Easygo? We’re a high-growth, high-velocity tech company with millions of eyeballs on us every day. We’re building the future of fearless tech. We’re the creators behind some of the most popular brands including Stake, KICK and Easygo Games. While they command a fierce global following, our crew is employed directly by Easygo and that’s where the real fun happens. We’re always looking for people who are hungry, humble and move fast. People who are ready to Unify , Disrupt and Evolve with us. With us you’ll grow faster and go further. Your work has impact. And that gives you an edge you can’t get anywhere else. The impact you’ll make: Partnership Strategy & Opportunity Identification Proactively identify, evaluate and prioritise digital media partnership opportunities across global and regional markets, balancing always-on investment with event and activation-led deals. Develop and maintain a structured opportunity pipeline, assessing each opportunity against clearly defined criteria across brand positioning, awareness, market authority and acquisition objectives. Build and apply a rigorous partner/publisher assessment framework, defining evaluation criteria tailored to different business objectives and ensuring a consistent, data-informed approach to partnership selection. Maintain visibility of global opportunities (relevant to .com) alongside the ability to identify cross-market efficiencies, for example, a single partnership that spans all LatAm markets rather than negotiating each individually. Negotiation & Commercial Management Lead the negotiation of partnership agreements including commercial terms, media commitments, exclusivity arrangements, deliverable guarantees, and renewal conditions. Own the end-to-end contract lifecycle for all digital media partnerships, from initial terms through to execution, performance review, renewal and renegotiation. Drive commercial rigour across the portfolio, ensuring Easygo consistently achieves favourable terms and measurable returns on all partnership investment. Oversee the investment budget in collaboration with regional leads, allocating spend across the portfolio in line with strategic priorities and performance outcomes. Direct Publisher Relationships Own and develop Easygo's direct publisher relationships, building a preferred partner network of premium media owners across key markets and categories. Lead the negotiation and management of direct inventory deals, including tenancy packages, sponsorship integrations, content partnerships and bespoke placement arrangements. Work in close collaboration with the Programmatic Lead to identify where SSP relationships and Private Marketplace (PMP) deals can complement or replace direct arrangements - bringing a commercial and strategic lens to inventory decisions while the Programmatic Lead owns technical execution. Collaborate with the Programmatic Lead on the development of PMPs for both always-on activity and short-term event-led activations (e.g. World Cup, major sporting events) - owning the commercial negotiation and deal structure while the Programmatic Lead governs technical setup and delivery. Integrated & Cross-Format Opportunities Represent the Paid Media team in integrated, cross-format partnership opportunities including events, ambassador deals, sponsorships with media assets and multi-channel activations. Collaborate closely with the Sponsorship team and relevant country managers to align paid media partnership strategy with broader sponsorship, brand and market initiatives. Ensure paid media assets within integrated deals are clearly scoped, executed to brief, and measured against both brand and performance objectives - preventing value leakage in complex, multi-stakeholder arrangements. Global & Multi-Market Scope Develop and maintain a global view of the partnership landscape, identifying where deals at .com level or spanning multiple regulated markets can deliver efficiencies and scale. Work with country managers and regional teams to understand local market needs, regulatory constraints, and audience nuances - ensuring partnerships are fit-for-purpose across every market they operate in. Balance global ambition with local relevance, ensuring partnership strategy serves both brand-building at scale and acquisition in specific regulated markets. Team Leadership & Development Lead and grow a team responsible for the day-to-day management of digital media partnerships, setting clear objectives, providing regular feedback and actively supporting career development. Build a high-performing, commercially minded team capable of managing a complex, multi-market partnership portfolio across brand and performance objectives. Contribute to hiring decisions as the team scales, and develop a team structure that reflects the breadth and ambition of the partnerships function. Brand Positioning & Cross-Channel Collaboration Serve as the Paid Media team's primary executor of Easygo's brand positioning strategy through paid partnerships, ensuring all partner environments, placements, and integrations reflect brand standards and reinforce strategic positioning. Collaborate with channel leads across Paid Search, Paid Social and Programmatic to ensure a cohesive, non-duplicative messaging strategy across all paid touchpoints. Contribute to integrated planning cycles - providing partnership forecasts, inventory insights, and activation plans to inform broader media and marketing strategy. Performance Measurement & Reporting Define and govern KPI frameworks for partnership activity across brand, awareness, and performance dimensions, ensuring measurement infrastructure is agreed and in place before deals go live. Oversee partnership performance reporting, delivering clear insights and recommendations to the Head of Paid Media and relevant stakeholders on a regular cadence. Apply performance learnings to continuously refine the partner assessment framework and guide future investment decisions. Compliance & Brand Safety Ensure all partnerships, placements and integrations meet the relevant brands' safety standards and the regulatory requirements of every market in which they operate. Work with Legal and Compliance teams to review partnership agreements, ensuring all activity is permissible, appropriately disclosed and aligned with market-specific advertising regulations. Factor regulatory constraints into partnership scoping and deal design from the outset - not as a post-deal check, but as a core part of how opportunities are evaluated and structured. Your track record: 6+ years of experience in digital media, with a strong track record in media partnerships, publisher development, or direct media sales/buying. Proven ability to identify, negotiate, and manage complex digital media partnerships, ideally in a multi-market or global context. Strong commercial acumen, experienced in contract negotiation, deal structuring, and budget management. Solid understanding of the digital media landscape, including direct publisher deals, inventory types, SSPs, PMPs, and how programmatic and direct channels complement each other. Experience working across integrated, cross-format opportunities including sponsorships, events, and ambassador deals with media assets. Demonstrated ability to build commercial assessment frameworks and evaluate partnership value across brand and performance dimensions. Experience leading and developing a team. Experience in wagering/igaming preferred. Bonus points if you also have: Experience in the gaming, entertainment, or sports industries. Existing relationships with major publishers, SSPs, or media owners. Familiarity with international media markets - particularly LatAm, Europe, or Asia-Pacific. Passion for sports and entertainment. Here are our benefits and perks: Sharpening your edge The ultimate sandbox. Exciting, on-the-job learning opportunities. 1 in 3 of our people level up their roles every year. If you deliver, you move. Competitive pay and bonus scheme Market-synced pay that respects your craft and location. Performance-based bonus recognition based on your impact (up to 20%). Help us build our crew and get paid for it with our high-value referral bonus. Because great people know great people. Other perks 18 weeks paid parental leave for primary carers Smooth Parental Return: Ease back into work with 12 weeks of transition support, including fully paid Fridays off during your first three months back Access to Employee Assistance Program Wednesday massages In-house baristas serve you free coffee, fresh juices and smoothies. Daily catered breakfast and regular company-wide events. Snack walls and drink fridges on every floor. Fun, modern office spaces. Pool tables, table tennis, gaming consoles and an F1 simulator. We play fair. We hire fair. True to our value of ‘Play fair’ we always hire fair. Our work and our brands are fuelled by our diverse culture. We hire for talent and grit. But we never discriminate. Your race, religion, nationality, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital, veteran, or disability status won’t affect our hiring decision, or your trajectory here. Come as you are and get the Easygo edge.

items.title: Sales Director, Japan
items.description: Fireblocks is the company bringing global finance onchain. Backed by over $1 billion in capital, we are the premier digital asset infrastructure provider trusted by thousands of industry-defining financial institutions, including banks, payment providers, fintechs, and global corporates such as BNY Mellon, BNP Paribas, ANZ Bank, Western Union, Stripe, and Revolut. Built for institutional scale and security, our enterprise-grade platform and network have powered over $14 trillion in digital asset transfers worldwide. Looking for an industry-leading, secure digital asset platform, experiencing hypergrowth valued at $8 billion? Welcome to Fireblocks! Here’s the bit about us: Fireblocks is an enterprise-grade platform delivering a secure infrastructure for moving, storing, and issuing digital assets & cryptocurrencies. Here at Fireblocks, we enable financial institutions to securely build, run and scale digital asset operations through the Fireblocks Network and MPC-based Wallet Infrastructure. Digital assets are protected from cyber-attacks, internal collusion, and human error using next-generation multi-layer technology. Fireblocks is the only platform that provides insurance for digital assets in storage, transfer, and E&O. As of January 2026, we serve over 2400 institutional customers, have secured the transfer of over $10 trillion in digital assets, and are the world’s highest-valued digital asset infrastructure company, with over $1 billion raised. Our mission is simple: Enable every business to easily and securely support digital assets & cryptocurrencies. Come join us as we Secure. Simplify. items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Claude is becoming the AI layer inside the platforms where enterprises already work. Our partnership with Salesforce — anchored by Claudeforce — is the first and largest example, and a growing roster of strategic technology partners is following the same path: making Claude the front door to their products for millions of users. As Marketing Manager, Tech Partnerships, you will own the ongoing comarketing relationship with these strategic tech partners. You will be the single marketing point of contact for each partner’s marketing organization, build and run the joint marketing plan, manage shared marketing funds, and turn large partnership agreements into pipeline-generating field programs — exec summits at partner flagship events, joint workshops, enablement moments, and co-branded activations around the world. Key responsibilities Own the day-to-day comarketing relationship with strategic tech partners, starting with Salesforce: be the one consistent Anthropic marketing voice your partner counterparts plan with, and keep both sides working from a single joint plan Build joint marketing plans with each partner, with goals and success metrics agreed before any shared funds are committed Manage joint marketing development funds (MDF): allocation across programs, spend tracking, compliance with partnership terms, and reporting on what the investment returned Design and execute flagship joint moments — executive summits and sessions at partner events (e.g., Dreamforce, World Tours), joint customer workshops, partner sales kickoff enablement, and co-hosted executive dinners Extend partner programs through the broader ecosystem, including joint activations with shared systems-integrator and consulting partners Measure what matters: partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, program-level attribution, and a partnership marketing health scorecard built with Marketing Ops Protect the brand: apply comarketing guidelines, run messaging and asset approvals in both directions, and know when to say no to a partner ask Operate as connective tissue across Anthropic: Partner Marketing, Partnerships/Business Development, segment field marketers, Product Marketing, Events, and Comms all touch these relationships. You keep them coordinated and the partner experience coherent Minimum qualifications Ownership of a comarketing relationship with a large strategic partner: a hyperscaler, a major SaaS platform, or an equivalent, including joint planning and MDF management A track record of executive-level field programs: summits, flagship-event activations, C-level dinners, and roadshows, with the pipeline to show for them Strong relationship-building skills: able to earn trust with partner marketing leaders while holding Anthropic's line on brand, messaging, and spend Comfort building in ambiguity: the playbook for this motion is being written now, and you'll write much of it Rigor on measurement: fluent in pipeline attribution with sales and ops counterparts Preferred qualifications 7+ years of B2B marketing experience, with significant time in field, partner, or alliance marketing at a technology company Experience on both sides of a platform partnership (at the platform and at the ISV/partner) Familiarity with the AI ecosystem and how enterprises adopt AI products Experience running programs at global scale across multiple regions and event series Experience working with or marketing through global systems integrators The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $255,000 — $320,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Anthropic's Beneficial Deployments team accelerates the work of organizations doing some of the world's most important under-resourced work: nonprofits, education institutions, scientific researchers, and organizations advancing economic mobility. Research institutions sit at the center of that mission. They produce the science the rest of the world builds on, and they are structurally short on time, budget, and technical capacity to figure out new technology on their own. You will lead our targeted approach to research institutes and research intensive universities globally. Where our scaled motion reaches thousands of organizations one to many, this role is the opposite end of the same ecosystem: a deliberately short list of institutions where depth matters, where a lab, a department, or a whole campus adopting Claude changes what science gets done, and where the buying process runs through provosts, research offices, procurement, grant budgets, and security review. Reach comes first, and commercial results follow from it. That ordering is deliberate and it is shared across every leader on this team: a research institute that adopts Claude to move its science faster is a win on its own terms, and you will be measured on creating that value with the institutions that matter most, not only on pipeline. You are the single accountable owner for the research Enterprise book globally: its target list, its AEs, its numbers, and its field voice inside Anthropic. You are half seller, half domain translator. You will personally run the most complex institutional deals, and you will be credible in a room of scientists and research leaders. You know how research is funded, how a university decides, and what it takes for a research sales motion to land in a software company. You will bring that knowledge to the product, applied AI, and marketing teams who build for this audience. This is a player coach seat. You will be directly involved in deals and directing the account executives who cover research institutes and universities today, and the role is expected to grow thoughtfully with more AEs in key regions globally. Direct and coach the account executives working research accounts today: joint account plans, deal reviews, and a repeatable motion for landing a university and expanding within it. Build the institutional playbook: how an institute goes from a pilot to a working deployment across a department, what good adoption looks like, and when to bring in applied AI, customer success, or partners. Own the book's numbers, institutions reached, activated, and expanded against goals, and use them to decide where the effort goes next. items.title: Private Equity Partnerships Manager
items.description: About Glean: Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles. At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level. Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality. If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company. About the Role: Glean is seeking a Private Equity Partnerships Manager to build and scale our ecosystem with leading private equity and investment firms. In this role, you will own relationships with top sponsors and drive adoption of Glean across their portfolios, sitting at the intersection of PE, AI, and enterprise transformation. You’ll structure and manage portfolio‑wide commercial frameworks, oversee deployment motions across PortCos, and ensure Glean delivers measurable EBITDA and enterprise value impact for PE‑backed businesses. This is a manager‑level, quota‑carrying role within Partnerships, working closely with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success. You are fluent in PE economics, comfortable navigating multi‑stakeholder environments across funds and PortCos, and able to manage AI value‑creation plays from term sheet through exit. Success is measured by converting PE partnerships into live deployments, pipeline, and revenue across your sponsors. You will: Drive PE partnership strategy & deal management Structure, negotiate, and execute PE partnership agreements (preferred pricing, portfolio‑wide frameworks, lighthouse PortCo plays). Draft reusable cross‑portfolio pricing and partnership agreements with Legal, Finance, and RevOps. Coordinate internal approvals and external sign‑off with GP leadership, operating partners, and PortCo executives. Maintain standardized pricing and commercial constructs so AEs have clear guidance on using PE frameworks in deals. Sponsor relationship management Serve as Glean’s primary day‑to‑day contact for multiple PE sponsors. Build deep relationships with operating partners, portfolio ops, deal teams, and technology/data leaders. Run recurring cadences (QBRs, portfolio and pipeline reviews, exec check‑ins) to surface and advance opportunities. Maintain current views of key contacts, portfolios, and in‑flight initiatives per sponsor. Portfolio activation & deployment oversight Drive PortCo activation by identifying high‑value AI use cases (e.g., GTM, finance, engineering, support/back‑office). Support scoping and oversee evaluation, pilot, and rollout cycles with AEs, AI Outcomes/CS, Solutions, and SIs. Coordinate with Product, Engineering, and partners to meet quality, security, and timeline expectations. Track and communicate deployment metrics (adoption, usage, revenue/cost/EBITDA impact) to sponsors and management teams. Revenue, pipeline & program performance Own pipeline development and revenue targets for assigned sponsors. Maintain a rolling forecast of opportunities across portfolios (sourced and influenced). Work with AEs to map portfolios, track activity, and prioritize accounts by sponsor focus, AI readiness, and value potential. Ensure clean partner/opportunity data in CRM and build dashboards for PE‑sourced/influenced pipeline, ARR, coverage, and velocity. Surface insights and recommendations to improve motions, offers, and enablement. Enablement & cross‑functional coordination Build and update concise enablement assets (one‑pagers, decks, FAQs, playbooks) for sponsors and PortCos. Develop case studies and portfolio‑level proof points; run enablement sessions and workshops to drive adoption. Design and execute programmatic engagement (fireside chats, webinars, roundtables, dinners) with PE and PortCo execs. Partner with Sales and Enablement on portfolio‑wide sessions and briefings. Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal, Security, RevOps, and Customer Success to move deals forward and feed learnings into the roadmap. Coordinate with SI / implementation partners on joint delivery, ensuring aligned messaging and execution. About you: Experience 5–10+ years in enterprise SaaS and/or fintech across partnerships, BD, sales, PE‑backed operating roles, or management consulting serving PE clients. Direct experience with technology partnerships with PE sponsors or multi‑entity / portfolio structures strongly preferred. Proven track record working with sales to drive pipeline and revenue (co‑sell, partner‑sourced deals, complex accounts). Strong program/project management skills: multiple concurrent workstreams, stakeholders, and deadlines with high attention to detail. Able to operate as both strategist and executor across cross‑portfolio deployments. PE & commercial acumen Strong familiarity with fund structures, GP/carry economics, value‑creation playbooks, and sponsor–PortCo dynamics. Comfortable with commercial discussions (pricing, discounts, basic economics) and iterating on term sheets within guardrails. AI & technical fluency Fluent in AI and agentic AI concepts; can credibly discuss Glean with technical teams and PE investors. Able to translate AI capabilities into portfolio‑level value creation narratives (EBITDA, efficiency, growth, multiple expansion). Communication & collaboration Excellent written and verbal communication; comfortable with C‑suite‑level decks and crisp internal updates. Proven ability to build trust and alignment across internal and external stakeholders in fast‑moving environments. Mindset Scrappy, curious, and excited to help define and scale Glean’s PE partnership motion. Thrive in ambiguity and shifting priorities. Passionate about AI’s potential to transform the economy and aligned with Glean’s mission to deliver safe, enterprise‑grade AI with real business impact. Location: This role is hybrid (4 days a week in our New York City office) Compensation & Benefits: The standard OTE (on‑target earnings) range for this position is $250,000 – $300,000 annually, with competitive equity and benefits. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive compensation, Medical, Vision, and Dental coverage, generous time-off policy, and the opportunity to contribute to your 401k plan to support your long-term goals. When you join, you'll receive a home office improvement stipend, as well as an annual education and wellness stipends to support your growth and wellbeing. We foster a vibrant company culture through regular events, and provide healthy lunches daily to keep you fueled and focused. We are a diverse bunch of people and we want to continue to attract and retain a diverse range of people into our organization. We're committed to an inclusive and diverse company. We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race. #LI-HYBRID AI-First Mindset at Glean: At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required. Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants: Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), or other privacy laws may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. Our full notice outlining how data will be processed as part of the application procedure for applicable locations is available in our Privacy Policy . By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. US applicants and their applications are subject to arbitration of disputes as outlined in our Applicant Arbitration Agreement . By clicking “Submit Application,” I confirm that I have read the Global Data Privacy Notice and the Applicant Arbitration Agreement , and I agree to the terms.

items.title: GTM Enablement - Sales Execution & North America Lead
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role We’re hiring a Sales Execution & NA Enablement Lead to raise how our enterprise sellers plan, pursue, and win complex, technical deals. This is not a traditional training role. You’ll set the standard for what great enterprise selling looks like, turn it into artifacts and operating rhythms, and make sure sellers and managers actually use it. The role has two mandates: own key global sales execution programs, and act as the primary Enablement partner to North America sales leadership. You’ll work closely with the Global Head of Enablement, Sales Leadership, RevOps, Product Marketing, Product & Technical Enablement, and FDE. What you’ll do - Own enterprise sales execution: Build and operationalize the critical artifacts that drive excellent sales execution. - Enable sellers to win technical enterprise deals: Coach reps to build business cases with champions, read 10-Ks, and connect ElevenLabs capabilities to measurable outcomes for technical and economic buyers. - Partner with NA leadership on enablement: Diagnose field gaps and adapt global programs to NA needs, including competitive positioning, developer-led motions, and vertical playbooks. - Facilitate globally: Lead highly engaging, practical sales execution sessions, not just build the programs behind them. - Manage the coaching and operating rhythm: Embed selling standards and artifacts into how managers inspect deals and coach sellers. - Build the foundation for a vertical selling motion: Lay the groundwork for vertical selling, which is becoming a global priority, not just an NA need. - Execute in an AI-native way: Use AI to scale coaching, practice, and reinforcement, going beyond general AI fluency. Requirements - 10+ years experience in enterprise sales leadership and enablement experience, ideally in an AI-native or developer-focused company - Excellence building and operationalizing value-selling artifacts across sales org with measurable results - Experience with MEDDICC, Command of the Message, Challenger, or similar methodologies, and the judgment to adapt them - Experience enabling frontline sales managers and building strong coaching methodologies - AI fluency, and comfort building in a fast-growing environment where the operating model is still taking shape - Enough technical depth to credibly support sellers selling to developers and technical buyers - Proven cross-functional influence across Sales, RevOps, PMM, Product, and FDE teams - Bonus: Experience working in voice AI Location This is a remote-first role. Candidates must be based in North America. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role This is a builder’s role, where you'll own both the technical depth and commercial outcomes for some of ElevenLabs' most exciting customers across Southern Europe, sitting at the intersection of product, engineering, and revenue. You'll get ahead of the problem. You'll dig into how customers deploy ElevenLabs across web, mobile, and their systems, spot the problems before they do, inspire new use-cases and own the solution end to end. You'll own the number too: renewals, expansion and cross-sell. Success here means driving real revenue retention and growth for your book of business. What this looks like day to day You'll run onboarding, enablement, and growth across ElevenLabs' full platform, core speech models, creative tools, and Agents. You'll advise customers on production deployment, not just theory, digging into usage and performance data to catch friction early and keep adoption moving. You'll also own commercial outcomes for a defined book of business against clear targets: Gross Revenue Retention, Net Revenue Retention, cross-sell, and net expansion. You'll spot expansion opportunities early, own renewals and upsells end to end, and work closely with Sales, Engineering, and CS leadership to turn technical wins into revenue. If you prefer, you can work from our office in Madrid or fully remote in Italy. #LI-Remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

items.title: B2B Ecosystem Lead, Business Development
items.description: About the Team: We are a small and fast-moving B2B partnerships team that shapes and executes OpenAI’s most important collaborations. We develop strategic and product partnerships across the B2B ecosystem, bringing together OpenAI’s capabilities and partners’ technology, expertise, data, workflows, and customer relationships. Working closely with Product, Engineering, and Sales, we turn these opportunities into useful offerings and new ways for businesses to adopt and benefit from OpenAI. About the Role: As a B2B Ecosystem Lead, you will identify, develop, and execute strategic and product partnerships across B2B segments. This is a hands-on individual contributor role spanning opportunity assessment, partnership design, commercial negotiation, and execution. You will own the partner work behind product initiatives, from defining partner needs through launch and sustained adoption at scale. These may include Sign in with ChatGPT and industry-specific offerings. You bring a generalist’s ability to connect product priorities with partner capabilities, build a business case, and align teams around a practical path forward. You will remain accountable after signing and launch, including for selected high-touch strategic partnerships. Key Responsibilities: - Identify strategic and product partnership opportunities across B2B segments; translate product priorities and customer needs into partner plans, joint value propositions, and a focused set of prospective partners. - Own the partner work stream for assigned product initiatives, aligning requirements, commitments, milestones, and ongoing responsibilities with Product, Engineering, and partner teams. - Develop business cases and negotiate product and commercial partnerships with Legal, Finance, and Product, including selected high-touch strategic deals in coordination with other partnership owners. - Take partner initiatives from pilot through launch and scale, defining readiness criteria, coordinating integrations, and expanding successful offerings to more partners and business customers. - Work with Sales and partner teams on target accounts, referrals, joint selling, and customer introductions, with clear responsibilities for follow-up and opportunity tracking. - Coordinate Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Legal, Finance, Security, Policy, and Operations to resolve launch and adoption barriers, with clear ownership and handoffs into ongoing partner programs. - Maintain partner relationships after launch and bring customer feedback, integration gaps, and adoption barriers back to Product and Engineering; help turn early implementations into repeatable offerings. - Define success measures with product and go-to-market teams, track activation, sustained usage, customer outcomes, and commercial impact, and drive follow-up when an initiative falls short. Qualifications: - 8+ years of experience in business development, strategic or product partnerships, or related roles developing commercial opportunities in technology or other B2B businesses. - Experience developing B2B partnerships and taking a product, integration, or partner initiative from concept or pilot through launch and sustained adoption, working closely with product and technical teams. - A broad business perspective and the ability to learn unfamiliar industries, evaluate partner capabilities and strategic fit, and turn an ambiguous opportunity into a clear business case and partnership plan. - Understanding of how businesses use software, data, and services, and how product integrations, distribution, and complementary capabilities create value. Experience across B2B sectors and business models is a plus. - Strong commercial and analytical judgment, including the ability to assess economics, prioritize competing opportunities, and use performance data to guide decisions. - Ability to build relationships with partner practitioners and leaders, work effectively across technical and business teams, and move projects forward without formal authority. - Clear writing and communication, curiosity about AI, and a willingness to do the detailed work of growing partnerships. You combine initiative and adaptability with disciplined follow-through. items.title: Account Manager
items.description: About us EveryMatrix is a leading B2B SaaS provider delivering iGaming software, content and services. We provide casino, sports betting, platform and payments, and affiliate management to 300 customers worldwide. But that's not all! We're not just about numbers, we're about people. With a team of over 1400 passionate individuals spread across twelve countries in Europe and Asia, we're all united by our love for innovation and teamwork. Join us on this exciting journey as we continue to redefine the iGaming landscape, one groundbreaking solution at a time. About the role As an Account Manager at EveryMatrix, you will be responsible for managing and nurturing key client relationships within the iGaming industry. You will serve as the primary point of contact for our clients, ensuring their satisfaction, and identifying opportunities for business growth. This role requires a deep understanding of both the iGaming industry and our software solutions. What You'll get to do: Conduct regular check-ins and business reviews with clients to assess their satisfaction, uncover challenges, and provide solutions. Prepare and deliver detailed reports on account health and revenue forecasts by usage metrics, and financial performance to both the client and internal stakeholders. Collaborate with the other commercial teams in identifying opportunities for upselling or cross selling our software and services to existing clients. Collaborate with the sales team to expand the client portfolio through referrals and networking Stay updated on industry trends and competitors to provide valuable insights to clients. Participate in industry events and conferences to expand your knowledge and network. Manage and develop relationships with clients within the assigned portfolio, acting as their primary point of contact Work with the Regional Account Director to define client objectives, annual plans, and strategic priorities; ensure effective execution and delivery of agreed commercial goals Partner with the Account Director in planning and delivering Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), ensuring alignment on client performance, strategy, and growth opportunities Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with key clients in the iGaming sector Understand client needs, objectives, and challenges, and translate them into tailored solutions Maintain deep knowledge of EveryMatrix products and effectively communicate their value to clients Collaborate with Product, Technical, and Delivery teams to ensure successful implementation and ongoing service quality Monitor client project progress, proactively resolve issues, and keep stakeholders updated Handle escalations professionally, ensuring timely and effective resolution Conduct regular client check-ins and support structured business reviews (QBRs) to drive satisfaction and identify growth opportunities Maintain accurate and up-to-date records in CRM and internal systems Prepare and deliver reports on account performance, revenue, and growth forecasts Collaborate with Sales and other commercial teams to drive upsell and cross-sell opportunities Support business growth through referrals, networking, and industry engagement Stay informed on industry trends, competitors, and regulatory developments Represent EveryMatrix at industry events and conferences What we’re looking for: Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field. A master's degree is a plus. Proven experience as an Account Manager or similar role in the iGaming industry. Good knowledge of the iGaming sector, including industry regulations and trends Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams. Problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to client needs. Proficiency in using CRM software and MS Office Suite.) Willingness to travel for client meetings and industry events when necessary. Performance Expectation: Achieve assigned revenue targets, growth objectives, and client KPIs Deliver against commercial plans and account strategies Contribute to overall client retention, satisfaction, and long-term value creation. Here's what we offer: Start with a competitive number of annual leave days, increasing as you grow with us. Enjoy additional annual sick leave days beyond the legal requirement, with no medical certificate needed for these days. Enjoy a flexible hybrid work schedule after your first three months with us. Parental support: Additional paid leave to support new parents, with options tailored for maternity and paternity. Flexible remote work opportunities during the first months of parenthood. Benefits and perks: Monthly lunch allowance. Gym Membership. Access to leading online learning platforms (such as LinkedIn Learning and Udemy for Business), plus an annual budget for external courses or certifications. Our office perks include frequent team-building activities in various locations. At EveryMatrix, we're committed to creating a supportive and inclusive workplace where you can thrive both personally and professionally. Come join us and experience the difference! EveryMatrix is a member of the World Lottery Association (WLA) and European Lotteries Association. In September 2023 it became the first iGaming supplier to receive WLA Safer Gambling Certification. EveryMatrix is proud of its commitment to safer gambling and player protection whilst producing market leading gaming solutions.

items.title: Sales Lead - Government
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re seeking an experienced Government Lead to build and scale our public sector business across North America. This is a rare opportunity to define the government GTM motion from the ground up - shaping how federal, state, and public sector organizations adopt voice and conversational AI. You’ll work directly with the founders, product, and the broader revenue team to identify high impact use cases across government agencies and regulated environments, build the pipeline, and close strategic deals. Success in this role means combining deep public sector expertise with a builder mindset: establishing our presence in the market while helping shape the long-term strategy for the government vertical. IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL - Build and own ElevenLabs’ Government GTM motion across federal, state, and public sector agencies in North America. - Identify and pursue strategic opportunities where voice and agents can transform government services, citizen engagement, and internal workflows. - Develop and execute account strategies across key agencies and departments. - Navigate complex procurement processes, compliance requirements, and multi-stakeholder buying environments. - Build trusted relationships with senior public sector leaders, procurement officials, and technical stakeholders. - Work closely with Product and Engineering to shape solutions that meet government requirements (security, compliance, deployment models). - Partner with Legal, Solutions Engineering, and Customer Success to ensure successful implementation and long-term expansion. - Represent ElevenLabs at government events, industry conferences, and strategic briefings. - Help define the long-term public sector strategy and vertical playbook as we scale the business. REQUIREMENTS - Have 8+ years of experience selling into government or public-sector organizations. - Have successfully closed complex deals within federal, state, or regulated environments. - Are comfortable navigating government procurement frameworks and long buying cycles. - Have experience building a new vertical or GTM motion from early stages. - Possess strong executive presence and can engage credibly with senior stakeholders. - Are passionate about how AI and emerging technologies can modernize government services. - Thrive in fast-moving environments where you operate both strategically and tactically. LOCATION While we operate as a remote-first company, there is a strong preference for this role to be based in Washington DC. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re hiring a Paid Media Manager to scale our paid acquisition across the full funnel and every segment—self-serve, developer, and enterprise–for emerging channels (e.g. Reddit, Snap, programmatic, et al). This role owns strategy and execution across the paid funnel, from channel mix and budget to creative testing and landing-page alignment, and is expected to find profitable, scalable growth through experimentation and data-driven decision making. The ideal candidate is platform agnostic, with proven, hands-on experience across multiple paid channels. You should be as comfortable optimizing for self-serve signups as you are for demo requests and lead quality, and as fluent in creative testing as you are in attribution and CAC math. This role is highly cross-functional and will partner closely with creative, lifecycle, landing-page, product marketing, and sales to drive impact. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role: - Lead the paid media function across all channels and segments as the team scales - Expand into broader growth or demand generation leadership - Move into full-funnel growth strategy or a channel-owner leadership role LOCATION This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in NA and EU. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in Dublin, London, New York, and Warsaw. #LI-Remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

items.title: Mobile User Acquisition Manager
items.description: ABOUT MEDIALICIOUS At Medialicious, we're a global growth marketing partner powering the expansion of fast-growing social gaming brands. Headquartered in Gibraltar, our mission is simple: to be the industry leader through deep domain expertise, constant innovation, and strategic scale. THE ROLE We are looking for a Mobile User Acquisition Manager to own hands-on acquisition performance across our portfolio of skill gaming and social gaming apps. Reporting to the Head of Mobile, you will turn the mobile growth strategy into scaled, profitable install and player acquisition across UA networks and app DSPs You will manage significant budgets, work closely with creative, BI, product and other acquisition teams, and use cohort, LTV and ROAS data to decide where capital goes next. You will bring direct experience acquiring players for skill gaming apps, and the judgement to scale them efficiently. WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING - You'll plan, launch and optimise app install campaigns across UA networks and app DSPs — AppLovin, Unity Ads, ironSource, Moloco, Liftoff and more — chasing quality players, not just cheap installs. - You'll turn the Head of Mobile's growth strategy into real channel plans, budgets and testing roadmaps, and report progress against shared mobile KPIs. - You'll live in the numbers: cohort, LTV, retention and ROAS analysis that tells you exactly when to scale, shift spend or pull the plug. - You'll work with BI and the Head of Mobile on MMP setup, attribution accuracy and incrementality testing, including SKAN and ATT. - You'll brief and iterate with creative on concepts and messaging that actually land with skill gaming audiences. - You'll partner with product, CRO and CRM to lift conversion, activation and retention — and keep every campaign inside platform and regulatory requirements. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR - Proven experience acquiring players for skill gaming apps — this one is non-negotiable. - A strong track record in mobile user acquisition and app performance marketing, scaling gaming apps and managing large media budgets. - Deep hands-on experience with UA networks and app DSPs (AppLovin, Unity Ads, ironSource, Moloco, Liftoff). - Confident with AppsFlyer (essential) and similar MMPs and mobile analytics tools. - Sharp analytical skills — cohort, LTV and ROI analysis, and the ability to turn messy data into clear optimisation calls. Incrementality testing and predictive LTV are a big plus. - Clear, direct communicator who works easily across creative, product, BI and analytics, thrives on changing priorities, and holds a degree in Marketing, Business Administration or similar. iGaming or social casino experience welcome. We're small, fast and allergic to bureaucracy. You'll have real ownership from day one, direct access to decision-makers, and the freedom to build something properly good rather than sit in meetings about it. How we work: open communication in Slack (not hidden in DMs), outcomes documented in Monday.com http://Monday.com, deadlines we actually agree and keep, cameras on for calls because we like feeling connected, and communication that says it in 20 words, not 1,000. Our values are simple — PASSION and PERFORMANCE. We love the product, we want to work with the best, we hold each other accountable, we choose progress over perfectionism, and we have a strict no-arsehole policy. If that sounds like your kind of team, we'd love to hear from you. EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES We hire based on skills, drive, and ideas — nothing else. Your background, gender, age, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, religion, neurodiversity, or educational path will never be a barrier to joining us. We also welcome candidates from non-traditional career journeys and value diverse perspectives that challenge conventional thinking. Diversity fuels our innovation, collaboration, and growth, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can contribute their best work and thrive.

items.title: Account Manager - Corporate
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. ABOUT THE ROLE You will own the full commercial relationship and customer’s success across a book of 100 to 200 corporate accounts - the builders, founders, and product teams at companies up to 250 employees who are defining what AI-native experiences look, feel, and sound like. Your job is to make sure every one of them is getting real value, expanding into new products, and renewing with conviction. This is a high-volume, high-impact role. You won't succeed by managing accounts one at a time - you'll build the systems, playbooks, and scaled motions that let you drive meaningful outcomes across a diverse book. If you love the challenge of figuring out how to operate at scale without losing the quality of the customer relationship, this role was built for you. On the ground, you'll be in the product with customers - advising on agent design, voice customization, conversation flows, integrations, and using data and logs to spot friction before customers do. You're the person who connects what's working technically to what's growing commercially and partnering closely with high growth accounts to help them achieve value. Success of the customer and commercial ownership go hand in hand and are at the core of this role. You own NRR across your managed book of business, you drive cross-sell into ElevenLabs’ expanding product suite, and you lead renewals end to end. The best AMs at ElevenLabs don’t just retain customers, they grow with them. COMPENSATION This role offers a competitive on target earnings (OTE) structure with a split of 70% base and 30% variable. Variable compensation is weighted 100% net revenue retention (NRR) with an emphasis on product cross sell. Cross-sell performance counts toward NRR, so strong expansion compounds across both components. Quota is set on managed ARR, giving you clear ownership over a defined book of business. The plan includes accelerators for above target NRR performance and is designed to reward account managers who grow with their customers, not just retain them. Variable compensation is paid on a quarterly basis. REQUIREMENTS - Minimum 2 years of Account Management or Customer Success experience in B2B SaaS, Developer Tools, or AI/ML products - you know what good looks like in a technical, fast-moving customer environment - A track record of owning commercial outcomes: quota, renewals, cross-sell, and the full expansion motion from identifying the opportunity to closing it - Comfortable managing a high-volume book of business with a systems mindset - you build playbooks and repeatable motions, not just individual relationships - Hands-on familiarity with AI concepts, API integrations, and SDKs; you can hold a technical conversation with a developer or engineering team and earn their trust - Experience using product usage data to stay ahead of your accounts - spotting health signals, identifying expansion opportunities, and getting in front of risk before it becomes churn - Strong communicator who can move fluidly between a founder, a technical lead, and a procurement team in the same week Preferred - Experience in the voice AI, audio AI, or conversational AI space - Experience selling or expanding into multiple products within a platform LOCATION This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in the United States, however the ability to operate in ET, CT, MT, or PT timezones is required. There is a preference for candidates to be based in New York City or San Francisco, with the option to work out of our offices in these cities. #LI-remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.
